title: PAH-OMC-020 stationary-modulus promotion-boundary correction
question: Do the pinned pi-weighted R-490 and R-522 bounds justify the bounded-stopping-time Aldous estimate used in the R-541 path-tightness wording, or only a deterministic-time stationary modulus?
finding: The finite martingale/drift algebra and stationarity give the exact deterministic-time bound E|f(X_(t+delta))-f(X_t)|^2 <= 2 delta K_Gamma+2 delta^2 K_L. R-490 and R-522 are pi-weighted averages, not pointwise-in-state or conditional compensator bounds, so the stopping-time upgrade is not implied. An abstract reversible two-state rare-state chain has decreasing stationary weighted rate average but a one-half jump probability after the rare state is hit at delta=log(2)/M. This is an implication boundary diagnostic only, not an exact PAH counterexample.
decision_reason: A successor correction is required rather than editing R-541: it preserves the finite deterministic statement and explicitly blocks an unsupported Aldous promotion. The correction keeps PAH-001, its rates, state, external time and j-before-anchored-n order byte-for-byte fixed.
boundary: Exactly unchanged PAH-001 functional, directed rates, labelled Gibbs stationary law, R-490/R-522 scope, external stochastic Markov time and preregistered j-before-anchored-n order. No new PAH carrier, process, rate, comparison map, counterterm or physical interpretation is introduced.

Derive the deterministic-time stationary two-square envelope with the unchanged source constants and explicit local root increments.
